senses.definition: Feeling ashamed, guilty, or uncomfortable because of something one did or a socially awkward situation.

examples.text: Se sentía muy avergonzado por haber mentido a sus amigos.
examples.translation: He felt very ashamed for having lied to his friends.
examples.emotion: regretful and quiet, admitting a mistake

examples.text: Estaba avergonzada después de caerse delante de todos.
examples.translation: She was embarrassed after falling in front of everyone.
